error.cannot_connect: The probe could not obtain a usable response from VeSync. Check the account details, country/API region and network connection, then try again.
error.invalid_otp: Enter the current numeric authenticator code.

{outcome}.

Safe metadata:
`{details}`

The output contains only sanitized protocol and compatibility metadata. Passwords, authenticator codes, account IDs, device identifiers, bizToken values, authorizeCode values, session tokens and raw VeSync responses are never included. Copy only these safe metadata lines.
result.title: VeSync authentication probe result

data_description.api_region: Use EU for accounts handled by the European VeSync service. Use GLOBAL for the US and other non-EU regions.
data_description.country_code: Two-letter ISO country code for the VeSync account, for example HU, DE, GB or US.
data_description.otp_code: Enter a fresh current numeric code from your authenticator app immediately before submitting. It is used only during this one run and is never stored.
data_description.password: Used only inside this diagnostic run. Plaintext is not stored by the probe.
data_description.username: Email address used by the VeSync account. It is not stored by the probe.

user.description: Version 0.9 runs the now-confirmed VeSync MFA flow. If VeSync returns a session token, the same run hydrates a fresh pyvesync manager with that token, performs one read-only device-list request, and compares the discovered device identity set with the already loaded Home Assistant Core VeSync manager when exactly one is available. The built-in VeSync integration, its config entry, devices, entities and registry are not changed.
user.title: Run VeSync 2FA session-compatibility probe
